proposed_capability: P141 selected a sparse semantic 3D Sims object map and local-camera affine relocalization; fifth gear P95/P82/P08/P07/P124 builds a pure evaluator and existing room traversal bridge. Floors and height (Y up), structural support/containment, wall mount offset and fresh viewport click recommendations are distinct. This is NOT inertial VIO or fully certified SLAM, nor a gameplay actuator.
player_save_control_impact: Pure functions inspect explicitly supplied, sanitized object and camera landmarks; no scans, Sims save reads, mouse/keyboard/OS effects, per-frame loops, persistent logs or new runtime listener. Existing player-first/screen_admit remains the sole input authority.
expected_outcome: Ground multi-floor object relationships, validate 3D pose/elevation, calibrate per-camera view with independent landmarks, abstain on stale/occluded/ambiguous target, expose read-only route via existing room traversal. Integrate with PR159 only after its independent writer is reconciled and actual local host P08 measured.
negative_tests: One 2D image cannot prove elevation or world coordinate
Collinear or coplanar landmarks deny calibration
Stale camera/capture denies projected click guidance
Occluded or ambiguous overlapping objects abstain
Missing independent capture evidence denies calibration
No object-map result grants input permit
rollback_path: Revert the isolated feature branch/PR; existing lot floor and world traversal owners unchanged; no disk runtime state migrated, no game/save mutation.
unresolved_unknowns: PR #159 independent spatial-perception writer remains unmerged
P08 actual screenshot sensor, EA geometry and patch calibration are not available in this provider
3D calibrated affine is local orthographic approximation, not general dense metric SLAM
decision_rationale: P141 comparison: reject dense video SLAM (no game camera depth/IMU or lawful calibration proof); weaken simple persistent pixel click atlas (fails on camera/floor/height); select sparse world-space object/elevation graph with reversible, bounded camera-projection evaluation. P95 identifies one canonical owner; P82 measures synthetic ground truth; P08 game runtime is local-only; P07 builds/tests; P124 integrates without duplicate PR159 sensor.
